name: Instruction Processing Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the status of an instruction.

CAN1.name: Cancellation 1
CAN1.definition: Pending cancellation; only one side has been input and a cancellation request has been sent.

CAN2.name: Cancellation 2
CAN2.definition: Pending cancellation; both sides have been input, the trade has not yet been matched, and one side has sent a cancellation request.

CAN3.name: Cancellation 3
CAN3.definition: Pending cancellation; both sides have been input, the trade is matched, and one side has sent a cancellation request.

CANO.name: Cancelled By Another Party
CANO.definition: Instruction has been cancelled by another party than the instructing party, for example, market infrastructure such as a stock exchange.

CANP.name: Pending Cancellation
CANP.definition: Cancellation request from yourself for this instruction is pending waiting for further processing.

CGEN.name: Generated
CGEN.definition: Account servicer or third party created the transaction. It was not instructed directly by the account owner.

COSE.name: Fully Executed Confirmation Sent
COSE.definition: Order is fully executed and the confirmation was sent.

CPRC.name: Cancellation Requested
CPRC.definition: Cancellation request from the counterparty is awaiting for your cancellation request or your consent.

DONE.name: Done
DONE.definition: Order is partially filled and no further executions forthcoming for the trading day.

DONF.name: Partially Filled Order
DONF.definition: Order is partially filled and no further executions will take place.

EXCH.name: Received At Stock Exchange
EXCH.definition: Order has been received at the stock exchange.

EXSE.name: Fully Executed Execution Sent
EXSE.definition: Order was fully executed and the execution sent.

FORC.name: Forced Rejection
FORC.definition: Message has been sent automatically by the service provider to notify that settlement will not take place.

FUTU.name: Future
FUTU.definition: All checks relative to the instruction (except collateral) are successful.

INTE.name: Received At Intermediary
INTE.definition: Order has been received at the intermediary.

NOTC.name: Already Matched And Affirmed
NOTC.definition: Instruction cannot be cancelled as it has already been matched and affirmed.

OVER.name: Over Allocated
OVER.definition: Quantity of financial instrument of the block trade has been overallocated.

PACK.name: Acknowledged Accepted
PACK.definition: Instruction has been acknowledged/accepted for further processing by the account servicer.

PAFI.name: Partial Fill
PAFI.definition: Order has been partially filled and the remaining quantity is warehoused.

PART.name: Partial Cancel
PART.definition: Order has been partially cancelled as requested.

PPRC.name: Pending Processing
PPRC.definition: Processing of the instruction is pending.

REJT.name: Rejected
REJT.definition: Instruction has been rejected for further processing.

REPR.name: In Repair
REPR.definition: Instruction is accepted but in repair.

SESE.name: Settlement Instruction Sent
SESE.definition: Settlement instruction has been sent to your custodian.

SUSP.name: Trading Suspended By Stock Exchange
SUSP.definition: Trading is suspended by the stock exchange.

TREA.name: Treated
TREA.definition: Transaction has been treated (triparty collateral status).

UNDE.name: Under Allocated
UNDE.definition: Quantity of financial instrument of the block trade has been under allocated.

MPRC.name: Modification Requested
MPRC.definition: Modification request from the counterparty is awaiting for your modification request or your consent.
